name: Reading Indian documents
description: Reads an uploaded bill, invoice or form exactly as written, in English, Hindi or Telugu, and keeps sensitive numbers out of memory.
verification: Figures come from the file's extracted text, which file_read returns; nothing is computed or saved by this skill.
